issue.title: Mac Pull-In card height policy ignores requirement rows, so requirement close cards clip their rows
issue.description:
Found by the bob-cli-pq land agent while checking the epic's Mac Pull-In render fixtures. Not caused by bob-cli-pq: the height policy predates the requirement rows, which bob-cli-on added on 2026-11-22 (bob-mac-capture bab5e5cc, 7006f3e7).

**Root cause.** In bob-mac-capture `Sources/BobMacCapture/CapturePullInChoiceView.swift`, `CapturePullInChoiceHeightPolicy.init(choice:displayScale:recallBandHeight:linkBandHeight:)` passes `rowCount: choice.rows.count`. `CapturePullInChoiceState.rows` holds only offer and blocked rows. Requirement rows live in `pullIn.groups[].rows` and surface as `CapturePullInChoiceSection.requirementRows` (`CapturePullInChoice.swift` `sections`/`makeRequirementSection`), so `listContentHeight`, `listViewportHeight`, `idealHeight`, and `minimumVisibleHeight` never count them. A requirements-only close card gets a list viewport sized for one section header plus caption and zero rows. In the live panel its requirement rows sit below the fold of a fixed-height `ScrollView`, and a mixed card is short by one row height per requirement.

**Evidence.** The exact-SHA macOS CI run https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/45255052132 (snapshot 2557ce113fe17f9c700538aba3f1ac72f0bfc982) uploaded the render-fixtures artifact. `requirement-pull-in-760-light.png` and `-420-*` (from `CapturePullInRequirementCardTests.testRenderPendingDroppedAndCarriedRequirementRows`, three requirement rows with Met/Drop/Carry staged) are only 262 px tall at 2x. The filter bar, the requirement section header ("Requirements · “Ship parser” 3 3 requirements / Met when it closes"), and a clipped sliver of the first row ("Handles supported input", "Met with task") are visible. The other two rows and every staged diamond are cut off by `previewMode`'s `.frame(height: policy.listViewportHeight).clipped()`.

**Fix.** Count each section's selectable `requirementRows` (the rows the card actually draws) in the policy's `rowCount`, and nested requirement fold rows if any. Add a height-policy unit test for requirements-only and mixed cards. Then confirm the regenerated `requirement-pull-in-*` fixtures show all three rows with their pending, slashed, and arrow marks. Run `Scripts/macos-ci-check` and watch exact-SHA CI.

task_type_fields.impact: Every Mac requirement close card is undersized; requirements-only cards show their rows only by scrolling, hiding the staged diamond marks and verdict capsules.
task_type_fields.repro: Run CapturePullInRequirementCardTests.testRenderPendingDroppedAndCarriedRequirementRows with BOB_MAC_CAPTURE_RENDER_DIR set (or download the render-fixtures artifact of CI run 45255052132): requirement-pull-in-*.png is 262px tall and shows only the header and a sliver of the first of three rows. Live: close a task with requirements and no successors in Bob Mac Capture; the Pull-In list viewport fits no requirement rows.

issue.creation_reason: Verifying bob-cli-pq's Mac render fixtures showed the Pull-In requirement rows cut off; the card's height policy counts only offer rows, a live layout defect inherited from bob-cli-on's requirement close card.
